name: CSOAI-ORG/meok-compliance-gateway
title: MEOK Compliance Gateway
description: MEOK Compliance Gateway — streamable-HTTP gateway for the CSOAI-ORG 28-hive MCP governance mesh. 13 unified governance frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2, CRA, CSRD, ESG, ISO 42001, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST AI RMF, supply-chain) + HMAC-SHA256 attestation chain + x402 USDC paywall. Built for cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Google Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps, Smithery, MCP.so, Glama, PulseMCP). First unified AI governance MCP — 13/15 GRC vendors have no MCP exposure (per sov3-mcp-master-audit-2026-06-08).

environmentVariables.name: MEOK_ATTESTATION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: HMAC-SHA256 attestation key. Resolved at startup from AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, HashiCorp Vault, stdlib keyring, or chmod-600 file fallback. Required — the gateway refuses to start without it (per CRITICAL_FIXES_2026-06-08.md Fix #3).

environmentVariables.name: MEOK_X402_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP wallet address for x402 USDC micro-settlement receipts. Free tier (100 calls/month) works without this; Team and Business tiers require it.

examples.name: Quick scan via meok-compliance-gateway
examples.description: Run a basic compliance check using the meok-compliance-gateway MCP server.
